I've been running a lot of numbers

So his Exalt, should generate a little over 110 STR at level 70ish including his wheel

For his 2 cost

1.    ⁠lets say 450 base dmg at level 70 + vul + 120% crit dmg lets assume around 1485 Corrosion
2.    ⁠450 Base + (5 X cost = 40 STR)(SF 10 1.5) 60 STR  + Vuln + 240% Crid DMG + E3 3 stacks of undertow 150%  = DMG 17,212.5 corrosion still isnt even that much....

150 STR = 35,437.5 corrosion

350 STR = 74,812.5 Corrosion

350 STR without using the X before hand and no undertow would be Corrosion 4,950

if you have 1000 STR, only 1 stack of undertow = 90,382.5 corrosion So if you can get your STR crazy hit the corrosion pops off

There are a lot of up and downs here. You want 3 stacks of undertow if you are going for corrosion build. 3 stacks of under tow means you need to use his 2 cost on 3 seperate turns. Each stack also gives you -1 DRAW. so 3 stacks you are starting a turn with 2 cards making it much harder to get your 2 cost to get that big stack of corrosion.

You also want to use his X cost at 5 arith which is another big ask

It doesnt seem like it will be a walk in the park to get around 1k+ STR but the more STR you get the more lenient you can be with your skills and undertow.

I think the first few turns of a battle will be just survive and stack up then around turn 5+ is when you start popping off big corrosion and holding onto undertow stacks but still, less draw sucks
